messages:
Nia (docs): Hey team, PR #4472 is blocked by preview - linkcheck + an API example that references `stream_timeout` which might be stale. Can runtime confirm current defaults and whether we should show SDK-level overrides?

preview-bot: Deploy preview 4472 - failed. Linkcheck: broken anchor /api/streaming#timeouts. Build logs: https://deploy.example/4472/logs

Sam (runtime): Current server-side stream timeout: hosted = 2 minutes (120s). We removed the public `stream_timeout` param on client calls; clients should use AbortController or SDK cancellation helpers.

Nia (docs): Thanks. The example shows `client.stream({ model, stream_timeout: 60 })` so that's definitely old. Tess, which SDK versions still accept that param?

Tess (sdk): SDK accepted that param up through v1.2.x. It was removed in v1.3.0. New pattern: pass an AbortSignal or use `client.withTimeout(ms, fn)` helper added in v1.4.0. Recommend pinning examples to v1.5.0.

Ravi (serving): Note: Dedicated customers on legacy configs may still have server-side 60s enforced. We standardized new Dedicated pools to 120s last quarter, but don't change the docs to say "always 120s" without a backcompat note.

Nia (docs): OK plan: 1) replace `stream_timeout` snippet with AbortController + note about `client.withTimeout` (pin to v1.5.0), 2) add a short callout: "Hosted default 120s; legacy Dedicated pools may be 60s, contact support for exceptions." 3) fix the broken anchor to the correct heading id.

Tess (sdk): I can quickly review the snippet once you push. Also add a one-line example for Python cancellation since many users copy both.

Nia (docs): Will push changes in ~20m. Preview-bot, please run new preview after that.

preview-bot: Build queued for deploy-preview 4473.

preview-bot: Deploy preview 4473 - success. Linkcheck fixed.

Tess (sdk): Snippet looks good and uses v1.5.0 helpers.

Ravi (serving): LGTM on the wording. Thanks for adding the backcompat note.

Nia (docs): Merged. Thanks all :rocket:
